_comment: Example spec for `gen_parts.py --parts references/parts-spec-example.json`. Every key except `name` is optional: omit them all and the built-in occlusion-complete prompt is used. Use this file when the character needs a naming convention or per-part detail the defaults cannot guess. Drop the _comment keys before use if you prefer strict JSON.

parts.name: head
parts.label: the character's head
parts.extra: Keep the freckles and the cowlick from image 1.

parts.name: hat
parts.extra: Match the hat's exact colour and stitching from image 1.
parts.negative: a head, hair, a face, a person wearing it

parts.name: torso
parts.extra: Include the whole jacket and the belt buckle in the centre.

parts.name: arm_l
parts.extra: The sleeve must match image 1 exactly.
parts.negative: a hand, a torso, a shoulder pad

parts.name: arm_r
parts.extra: Same sleeve as arm_l, mirrored for the other side.
parts.negative: a hand, a torso, a shoulder pad

parts.name: leg_r
parts.extra: Same trouser cuff as leg_l, mirrored.

parts.name: tail
parts.extra: The tail is fluffy; draw the whole shape including the base.
